messages:
Alex Ruiz: Postmortem follow-up: recurring "stutter" on streaming/chat: partial token bursts, 2-6s silent gaps, then resume. Suspect handshake/reconnect + rate-limiter + KV-cache cold-start. Need owners & short timelines.

Maria Ng: Ill own observability. Adding inter_chunk_gap_ms per-session, 95p histogram, and an alert if 95p > 3s over 10m. Dashboard link by EOD Thu.

Kevin Choi: I'll own runtime experiment. Plan: canary extend handshake timeout 2s->6s, instrument whether reconnect causes KV reseed, and try skip-reseed for reconnects within 10s. Running Friday AM.

Sarah Li: I'll draft customer-facing note and coordinate with support; hold sending until mitigations validated.

Alex Ruiz: Action items: Maria (obs & alert) EOD Thu; Kevin (canary & KV trace) Fri AM; Alex (short-term SDK guidance & reduce rate-limiter for warm sessions) target Wed next week; Sarah (comms) Fri. Update INC-10021 with checkboxes.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-10021 created and assigned to #incidents.

Kevin Choi: quick log example:
[2026-03-22T21:10:02Z] session=s1 chunk=4
[2026-03-22T21:10:03Z] session=s1 chunk=5
[2026-03-22T21:10:07Z] session=s1 chunk=6  <-- 4s gap

Maria Ng: I'll run a synthetic: 800 concurrent sessions @1t/s to surface backpressure and correlate gaps to node_id/model_variant.

Alex Ruiz: If canary improves, we'll release SDK patch recommending reconnect jitter + capped backoff and reduce rate-limiter aggression for warmed sessions.

Kevin Choi: ACK. Will post canary results + small PR for skip-reseed trace flag in this thread.

Maria Ng: ACK. Dashboard + alert rule posted here when ready.

Sarah Li: ACK. Draft comms will be in INC-10021 for review.

Alex Ruiz: Next sync Mon 11:00 PT. Escalate to eng-infra if node_id or cross-region correlation shows up.
